definitions.explanation: A physically high or elevated location. Often used in compounds related to fear of heights or high-altitude work.

examples.japanese: {高所|こうしょ}⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a fear of heights.
examples.notes: 高所恐怖症 is a very common compound

examples.japanese: {高所|こうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
{高所|こうしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろした→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧。
examples.english: I looked down on the town from a high place.

examples.japanese: {高所|こうしょ}⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{観覧車|かんらんしゃ}→観覧車：09221_kanransha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乗|の}れない→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I'm afraid of heights, so I can't ride a Ferris wheel.

notes:
{高所|こうしょ} refers to a physically elevated location, typically high enough to pose danger or offer a commanding view. It is more formal and technical than everyday words like ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧ and appears frequently in safety regulations, construction contexts, and medical terminology for phobias.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高所|こうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to work at heights)
- {高所|こうしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (to fall from a high place)
- {高所|こうしょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧ (to look down from a high place)
- {高所|こうしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧ (to climb to a high place)

COMPOUNDS:
- {高所|こうしょ}⟦{恐怖症|きょうふしょう}→恐怖症：27678_kyoufushou⟧ (acrophobia, fear of heights)
- {高所|こうしょ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (work at heights)
- {高所|こうしょ}{作業車|さぎょうしゃ} (aerial work platform)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高台|たかだい}→高台：14683_takadai⟧: a naturally elevated area or hilltop, used for geographical features
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧: casual everyday expression for a high place
- {高所|こうしょ}: more technical or formal; often implies risk or regulation
